title: My Haunted Hometown
description:
S01 E05 — Haunted Battlegrounds
Marching into three small towns where the American Civil War once raged; crossing paths with terrifying entities that make residents' skin crawl; meeting a man who unwittingly awoke malevolent spirits while trying to preserve his town's history.

title: My Haunted Hometown
description:
S01 E06 — Poltergeists
Uncovering the identity of rage-filled things that go bump in the night; going ghost hunting in a community theater in a town with a violent past; visiting a spooky honky-tonk; chasing a phantom that's trying to eject a historical home's new owner.

title: Alien Files Reopened
description:
S01 E01 — Summer of the Saucers
In the summer of 1952, stories of U.S. Air Force jets chasing UFOs over the White House knock the Korean War off the front pages of newspapers; as rumors spread, President Harry S. Truman demands to know what was flying over his house.

title: Alien Files Reopened
description:
S01 E02 — The Tall Whites
A young recruit encounters aliens in the Nevada desert in the 1960s; he claims they were working with the US military and housed a spaceship in a secret hangar nearby.

title: Alien Files Reopened
description:
S01 E03 — Billy Meir, The Plejaren and the Multiverse
Billy Meier claims he's traveled through time and space with an alien race from the Pleiades star cluster; in the decades following his revelation, both skeptics and ufologists say it's a hoax despite Meier providing photographic evidence.

title: Alien Files Reopened
description:
S01 E04 — Paul Bennewitz and Project Seven Lambs
In 1978, UFO enthusiast Paul Bennewitz claims he's intercepted extraterrestrial messages; military officials send counterintelligence officer Richard Doty to feed Bennewitz lies, questioning whether Doty himself is a pawn in an even bigger scheme.

title: Alien Files Reopened
description:
S01 E05 — Rendlesham Forest, Back from the Future
In 1980, a UFO detected on military radar, lands near crucial NATO bases; a group of military personnel claim to have seen a shiny metallic object with colored lights and hieroglyphic inscriptions.

title: Alien Files Reopened
description:
S01 E07 — The Belgian UFO Wave
Triangle shaped hovering objects are seen by thousands of people and investigated by scientists and government officials, yet they could never be explained; the sightings occurred in a more than two year wave over Belgium, beginning in late 1989.

title: Alien Files Reopened
description:
S01 E107 — School's Out for Saucer
On a September morning in 1994, students at a Zimbabwe school witness a silver craft land in a nearby field; numerous adults corroborate the UFO sighting, but the children are silenced; many maintain their account of the incident is true.

title: Alien Files Reopened
description:
S01 E08 — Negative Energy
Lt. Ryan Graves and pilots in his squadron detect and engage with UFOs on multiple occasions; he gave a detailed description of regular encounters that flight teams had with a black box UFO they were seeing every day.
